paper.title: Online Resource Allocation With General Constraints

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic setting (ORA with budget and general constraints)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Online resource allocation: the full input (reward, cost and consumption functions) of the current round is revealed BEFORE the action is chosen; no bandit or partial feedback.
unmapped: input tuple (f_t, g_t, h_t) revealed before the decision
m general long-term constraints with costs in [-1,1] (cumulative violation measured) plus n hard budget constraints with consumption in [0,1]
budgets B_j = Omega(T) known to the learner
void action with zero reward, cost and consumption exists
benchmark is the dynamic offline optimum OPT(gamma) over action sequences satisfying the constraints
Slater parameter rho unknown to the learner
settings.definition_quote: In the stochastic setting, the inputs are drawn i.i.d. across rounds from a fixed but unknown probability distribution $\mathcal{P}$ supported on $\Gamma$. ... $R_T := \text{OPT}_\text{stoc} - \mathbb{E}_{\bm{\gamma} \sim \mathcal{P}^T}[\texttt{Rew}(T, \bm{\gamma})]$.

settings.name_in_paper: Adversarial setting (ORA with budget and general constraints)
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Online resource allocation: the full input of the current round is revealed before the action is chosen; no bandit feedback.
unmapped: general long-term constraints plus hard budget constraints
alpha-regret with alpha = rho_adv/(1+rho_adv) against the dynamic offline optimum
settings.definition_quote: In the adversarial setting, the dynamic-optimum is defined as $\text{OPT}_\text{adv} = \text{OPT}(\bm{\gamma})$ for a given fixed input sequence ... $\alpha\text{-}R_T := \alpha \cdot\text{OPT}_\text{adv} - \texttt{Rew}(T)$, where $\alpha := \nicefrac{\rho_\text{adv}}{1 + \rho_\text{adv}}$

symbols.M_cons: total number of constraints M = m + n (general + budget)
symbols.rho: Slater parameter rho_stoc (feasibility margin), unknown to learner

source.label: vt
source.quote: Let $\delta\in(0,1)$. Both in the stochastic and the adversarial setting, Algorithm~\ref{alg:alg1} with learning rate $\eta := ...$, attains with probability at least $1 - \delta$: $V_T \leq 840 \frac{M^2}{\rho} \sqrt{2T \ln( T^2/\delta)}$ ... Moreover, the budget constraints are deterministically satisfied

results.notes: Cumulative violation of general constraints, stochastic case (rho = rho_stoc). Budget constraints satisfied deterministically.

symbols.M_cons: total number of constraints M = m + n
symbols.rho: Slater parameter rho_adv, unknown to learner

source.label: vt
source.quote: Both in the stochastic and the adversarial setting, Algorithm~\ref{alg:alg1} ... attains with probability at least $1 - \delta$: $V_T \leq 840 \frac{M^2}{\rho} \sqrt{2T \ln( T^2/\delta)}$, where ... $\rho \coloneqq \rho_\textnormal{adv}$ in the adversarial setting.

results.notes: Adversarial case of the violation bound.

symbols.M_cons: total number of constraints M = m + n

source.label: st_re
source.quote: Let $\delta\in(0,1)$. Consider Algorithm~\ref{alg:alg1} with learning rate $\eta = ...$. With probability at least $1 - \delta$, in the stochastic setting it holds: $R_T \leq \frac{1}{\beta_{\text{min}}} + \frac{60 M \sqrt{2 T \ln( T^2/\delta)}}{2 \beta_{\text{min}}^2} + \frac{\sqrt{T}}{120 \sqrt{2 \ln( T^2/\delta)}}$.

results.notes: R_T = OPT_stoc - E[Rew] is an expectation against the dynamic constrained offline optimum, yet the theorem is stated 'with probability at least 1-delta' (delta enters via eta); recorded as stated. Comparator is the constrained dynamic optimum sequence.

symbols.M_cons: total number of constraints M = m + n

source.quote: Let $\delta\in(0,1)$. Consider Algorithm~\ref{alg:alg1} with learning rate $\eta = ...$. With probability at least $1 - \delta$, in the adversarial setting it holds: $\alpha\text{-}R_T \leq \frac{1}{\beta_{\text{min}}} + ...$

results.notes: alpha-regret with alpha = rho_adv/(1+rho_adv) against the dynamic constrained offline optimum; quantity 'other' since it is alpha-regret.
